title: Grateful Dead Live at Saratoga Performing Arts Center on 1983-06-18
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 03/2012
source: AUD: 2x Beyer M-88's > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90s, recorded from inside the pavilion, directly behind the soundboard area, taped by Joe Morrone.

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a stellar 1983 show highlighted by an insane Scarlet Begonias→Fire on the Mountain, epic Morning Dew and a marathon Playing in the Band.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate this performance highly, praising the band's inspired playing—especially Jerry’s soaring Scarlet solo, Phil’s bass bombs, and a monster Morning Dew. The tape is praised as the best of the audience recordings despite lacking a soundboard source, delivering clear enough sound to enjoy the long PITB jam.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 4‑star reviews consistently praise both the musical performance and the audience recording quality, indicating a strong show with a top‑tier tape.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience source; reviewers call it the best of the audience recordings, noting clear capture of instruments and ambience despite the absence of a soundboard.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows powerfully with a fiery Scarlet>Fire sequence, an emotional Morning Dew, and an extended 18‑minute Playing in the Band that showcases the band's improvisational peak.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Outstanding solo on Scarlet Begonias→Fire; voice noted as croaky but still solid for the era.
band_member_comments.Phil: Drops bombs during the jams, especially in the Scarlet>Fire and PITB sections.
